criteria.name: profile_schema
criteria.description: All 5 layers defined with concrete fields, types, and examples; L5 Interest Cards have trigger patterns, expiry logic, and card schema specified

criteria.name: generation_pipeline
criteria.description: Each layer has input signals, LLM prompt template, trigger condition, and merge strategy defined; L3 prompt example is concrete and realistic

criteria.name: storage_architecture
criteria.description: P99 <5ms requirement addressed with credible solution (e.g., Redis + persistent store); caching strategy specified; async write path defined; 10M user scale considered

criteria.name: llm_pipeline_detail
criteria.description: Batching strategy defined; model choice justified by cost/quality tradeoff; output parsing and failure handling specified

criteria.name: evaluation_framework
criteria.description: Offline and online eval metrics defined; A/B test design is specific and measurable; privacy compliance check included
